prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: mobile-first web app direction comp, portrait iPhone screen
Primary request: a shippable Open Calory Tracker home screen in an Action-Only Consumer Surface visual system, where one comfortable card holds each decision and saturated color appears only where the user can act.
Structure: compact top bar; nearby-date strip; fixed calorie summary; swipeable nutrient group card; food log card; water quick actions; persistent bottom navigation; Add food as the primary action.
Subject/content: Saturday, August 29; Mock data label; 1,420 / 2,050 kcal; Greek yogurt with blueberries 320 kcal 8:12 AM; Turkey & avocado sandwich 540 kcal 12:36 PM; water 40 / 80 fl oz; protein 72 / 120 g; carbs 131 / 230 g; fat 44 / 70 g; fiber Incomplete; USDA FoodData Central attribution.
Style/medium: realistic polished product UI, not concept art. Warm tinted ground, white soft-cornered cards, comfortable humanist sans, dark evergreen text, a single saturated teal reserved strictly for actionable elements, disabled controls lose color, soft press affordances with no decorative bounce.
Composition/framing: full portrait 9:16 app viewport, no device frame; generous touch targets; one calm scrolling column with a persistent thumb bar.
Constraints: mobile web app; English; practical WCAG-conscious hierarchy; no food photographs, no illustrations, no judgmental red warnings, no gamification, no streaks, no badges, no medical claims, no fake logos, no watermark; render provided labels accurately and do not invent claims.
